text:
Cory (CS): Hey team, Parasol's cutover to Redwood Private is scheduled next Friday 09:00 PT. Quick sync: need a short checklist for network, IAM, KMS and audit-logs so Parasol ops can validate before we flip traffic. Can owners drop blockers or 'all green' below?

Parasol Ops: Thanks — we have a dry-run tomorrow. Main asks: 1) confirm where KMS CMKs will live (Redwood-managed vs customer-managed), 2) can we point audit logs to our S3 bucket (cross-account), 3) expected IP ranges for maintenance windows so we can pre-authorize.

Jordan (Network): For maintenance IPs I can provide an allowlist CIDR block range. Also confirm: Parasol wants VPC peering (regional) or PrivateLink? Peering is fine but requires route table updates on their side. PrivateLink would need NLBs and ENIs on our side. Which do they prefer?

Parasol Ops: Prefer peering to avoid extra LB costs. Route table changes are ok if we give exact entries. Also, do we need dedicated transit gateway? Not for initial prod, just peering.

Sam (SRE): Network checklist from our side: 1) VPC peering established + routes propagated, 2) NAT/egress path validated, 3) DNS resolution for service endpoints (we use privatelink-style internal hostnames), 4) healthcheck ports accessible from their subnets. Quick smoke test we run: `curl -v --resolve api.redwood.private:443:10.2.5.6 https://api.redwood.private/health` — Jordan I'll share exact IPs.

Priya (Security): IAM/KMS notes: we strongly prefer customer-managed CMKs (in their account) for parity with compliance requests, but Redwood can host a dedicated key if they require. If customer-managed: they need to create a key policy that grants Redwood's cross-account principals decrypt/encrypt/use. Minimal example policy snippet to share with Parasol: 

```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowRedwoodUse","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDCLOUD:role/redwood-kms-access"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

Priya (Security): Also: enable key rotation, grant CloudTrail access for audit (see next line), and confirm alias naming convention.

Cory (CS): Parasol — for audit logs we can ship to your cross-account S3 bucket. We'll need a bucket ARN and a short IAM role trust policy so Redwood can put objects. We'll send the exact policy template in the onboarding doc. Any retention/legal constraints we should know?

Parasol Ops: Retention: 7 years, must be encrypted SSE-KMS with customer key. Also we need object-level logging to show who accessed logs. We'll share bucket ARN and legal contact.

onboard-bot: Checklist item added: network/peering, route table entries, nat/dns smoke test, IAM role for service, CMK policy template, cross-account S3 logging role, audit retention config. Status: 0/8 complete.

Jordan (Network): Action items for tomorrow's dry-run: I'll post CIDRs and exact route entries. Also will attach a small terraform snippet they can apply: 

```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  vpc_id = "vpc-aaaa"
  peer_vpc_id = "vpc-bbbb"
  auto_accept = true
}
```

Sam (SRE): I'll coordinate the healthcheck and provide the curl/resolution steps for their ops. If we hit firewall issues, we'll escalate to parity.

Priya (Security): I'll email the CMK policy + S3 trust policy templates and include least-privilege guidance. Parasol if you can paste the bucket ARN here, I'll pre-populate the template.

Parasol Ops: Bucket ARN: arn:aws:s3:::parasol-redwood-audit-logs. We'll review CMK template after you post. Also small UX ask: can we get a short post-cutover checklist to confirm success (e.g., metrics to watch, error thresholds)?

Cory (CS): Yes — we'll produce a 1-page post-cutover runbook with KPIs (error-rate, p50/p95 latency, token cost spikes) and a 2-hour rollback play. I'll drop that after the dry-run.

Parasol Ops: Great, thanks. One renewal-risk note: legal wants confirmation on KMS ownership after 6 months — we'll need that in the contract addendum.

Cory (CS): Noted, I'll loop legal and capture that as an outstanding pre-cutover requirement. If others are truly all green, react with :thumbsup: and we'll close the pre-cut checklist.

Jordan (Network): :thumbsup: — I'll post CIDRs in 15m.

Priya (Security): :thumbsup: — uploading templates to the ticket.

Sam (SRE): :thumbsup: — will run smoke tests in the dry-run and report results.

Parasol Ops: :thumbsup: — thanks everyone, see you tomorrow for the dry-run.
